abbr_labels: Model p / Sim p / gap headers use <abbr title> with family and sign definitions
dialog_popover: none used; disclosures are native <details> with keyboard-operable <summary>
direction_not_color_only: every signed gap pairs value with simulation higher / model higher / equal words
focus: visible focus via global :focus-visible rule; driver buttons and anchor buttons keyboard-operable with aria-pressed
heading_hierarchy: h1 page title, h2 section titles, h3 inspector subsections
hover_only_explanations: none; all explanations are static text or native details
keyboard_driver_selection: driver names are native <button aria-pressed> in row headers; verified SAINZ selection via keyboard-role query
landmarks: banner nav (Primary), main, table with caption, row/column scopes
reduced_motion: global prefers-reduced-motion rule in frontend/app/globals.css; no motion on this page
status_not_color_only: every status is a text StatusChip with role=status
wilson_visualization: role=img with full aria-label (k, n, p_hat, interval bounds, sampling-only qualification); numeric text beside graphic
